CREATE TABLE "public"."orderNotificationDelivery" (
  "attempts" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deliveredAt" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lastErrorCode" character varying(80),
  "leaseUntil" timestamptz,
  "orderId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "recipientType" character varying(16) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "notification_attempts_d5e9f5f8" CHECK (attempts >= 0 AND attempts <= 5),
  CONSTRAINT "notification_recipient_5f9d9902" CHECK ("recipientType" IN ('customer', 'bakery')),
  CONSTRAINT "orderNotificationDelivery_status_check_d698e316" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'SENDING', 'SENT', 'FAILED', 'SKIPPED'))
)
